This is a Windows-only desktop tool that helps you generate Content Patcher packs without writing JSON by hand. It supports two main workflows:

[list=1]
[*]Stardew 1.6 Appearance system (recommended for seasonal/work outfits): generates Appearance entries in Data/Characters → [NPCName, Appearance] and the required Load actions.

[*]Image patching (EditImage): generates standard EditImage patches for tilesheets/spritesheets (as-is, resize, extract tile, or slice block).

[/list]This tool does not edit game files directly and does not use XNB edits. It only creates a Content Patcher content pack folder (manifest.json, content.json, and assets).
Requirements

[list]
[*]Windows (this release is tested on Windows only)
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+
[*]SMAPI 4.x+
[*]Content Patcher (Pathoschild.ContentPatcher)
[/list]What the tool outputs

The tool creates a content pack folder containing:

[list]
[*]manifest.json
[*]content.json
[*]assets/ (your portrait/sprite PNGs or exported tiles)
[/list][b]Recommended: Use the Appearance Builder (Stardew 1.6 outfits)
[/b]
Use this if you already have a complete portrait PNG (and optionally a sprite PNG) and want the tool to generate the Appearance entry + Load actions automatically.

[b]Step by step:
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Launch the tool.

[*]Set “Mode” to: Appearance entry (EditData + Load)

[*]Input PNG: select your portrait PNG (complete portrait file).

[*]Optional: Sprite PNG: select the character sprite PNG if you want the outfit to change the sprite too.

[*]NPC name: enter the NPC’s internal name (example: Abigail, Lewis, Anthony).

[*]Outfit name: enter a label like Outfit1, WinterWork, ShopOutfit, etc.

[*]Seasons (optional):
[list]
[*]Check the season(s) you want this outfit to apply to.
[*]Keep “Split by season” enabled if you select more than one season (it creates one entry per season).
[/list]
[*]Condition:
[list]
[*]Default is TRUE (always allowed).
[*]If you want “only while working”, enter a game state query condition (advanced; depends on your mod logic).
[/list]
[*]Indoors/Outdoors/Is island attire:
[list]
[*]Set where the outfit is allowed.
[/list]
[*]Click Build Pack.

[*]Move the generated folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder (or enable “Install into Mods folder”).

[/list][b]Notes

[/b][list]
[*]If you do not provide a Sprite PNG, the tool will generate an Appearance entry that changes the portrait only.
[*]If you want the output to match wiki examples more closely:
[list]
[*]Select a Sprite PNG so the output includes “Sprite”.
[*]Select a season (e.g. Spring) so the output includes “Season”.
[*]UniqueID and entry keys will use your real mod UniqueID, not the wiki placeholders like {{ModID}}.
[/list][/list][b]Alternative: Use EditImage (tilesheets/spritesheets)
[/b]
Use this if you are patching images directly (objects/crops/tilesheets), not the appearance system.

[b]Modes
[/b][list]
[*]As-is: copies the PNG (optional crop/pad) and patches it at destination X/Y.
[*]Resize to cells: forces the entire image to an exact tile size (N×M cells).
[*]Extract single tile: pulls one tile from a sheet by source X/Y and patches it to destination X/Y.
[*]Slice & patch block: splits a sheet into tiles and generates one patch per tile.
[/list][b]Important:
[/b]
In EditImage modes, “cell size” is the grid unit for tile math. It does not automatically shrink your image unless you use Resize mode.

Common mistakes / troubleshooting
[list]
[*]“It keeps targeting objects”
Grid preset only changes cell size. Use the Target field directly, or use Target Preset. Enable Lock Target to prevent accidental changes.[*]“My output doesn’t look like the wiki template”
The wiki uses placeholders like {{ModID}}. This tool writes real values (your UniqueID, NPC name, outfit name). Functionally it’s the same.[*]“No Sprite field appears in my Appearance entry”
You did not select a Sprite PNG. Select one if you want the entry to include Sprite and load it.[/list]Beta status and feedback

This is a beta release for public testing. It has received limited testing and will improve based on user reports.

If you try it, please include:
[list]
[*]which mode you used (Appearance or EditImage)
[*]your NPC name / target asset
[*]your season/condition settings
[*]your generated content.json and any SMAPI errors
[/list]
